details.completeness_justification: The candidate summary adequately covers the core material meaning of K1 (revenue, net profit, margins), K2 (apartment handovers), K3 (primary sales agreements), K4 (profitability pressures), K5 (bond offering), and K7 (development projects). However, it omits the core material meaning of K6 (portfolio expansion details), K8 (Toronto City Council approval), K9 (planned 2026 projects), and K10 (loan agreement with BluOr Bank). The summary captures most of the high-importance material information but lacks several key project-specific and forward-looking details, resulting in a 'Generally yes' rating.
